positions.name: ReleaseGateRequirement
positions.frame: What must be true of a release artifact before it reaches staging or production, and who holds that requirement?
positions.why: The directive (src-1), the recorded gate rule (src-4), its scope to staging and production (src-5), and the named owner (src-6) all state one requirement: a signed release manifest gates Meridian deploys. The justification (src-2) cites two unsigned artifacts that reached staging last quarter as the reason for the gate, so the frame reads both the rule and its stated cause. Tension is present but not resolved: src-1 performs the requirement as settled command, while src-2 offers a concrete prior incident as grounds. The rule is held in force by authority, and its warrant is a past consequence.
